You Conduct the 20-minute exploratory call with the Millfield Community Credit Union small business lending manager. Lead with the three-minute disruption-period pitch: I am David Chen, former branch manager at First Community Bank, I identified the auto loan contraction 12 months before the volume index confirmed it, I built the scenario models, and I have spent the past nine months completing SBA 7(a) commercial lending coursework specifically because I saw this transition coming. I am not looking for any job — I am looking for a role where someone who can read sector disruption early and translate it into lending strategy is an asset, not a liability. I bring the call materials: the three-scenario auto loan contraction document I built for the branch and shared with Linda Park, the SBA coursework completion certificate (or near-completion status if not finished before the call), and one page of data on small business credit demand in Millfield during disruption periods — drawn from the policy cancellation data Linda shared with me. The goal of this call is not to close a deal. The goal is to leave them with a specific follow-up: either a second conversation, an introduction to another person at the institution, or a named referral elsewhere. A warm lead does not become a job unless I convert this call into a next step.. Savings dropped by $6,961.
